BiblicalUsage: Rôqach is the word for an aromatic. It stands in Exodus 30:25, "…an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound…", and in Exodus 30:35, "…art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure holy".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rôqach is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
